versions.changelog:
Version 2.2.1

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- The skill remains functionally and descriptively the same as the previous version.

- Removed scripts/minimax_token.py and scripts/minimax-token.service from the project.
- Main script and systemd service configuration are no longer included.

- Added LICENSE file for open source clarity.
- Updated documentation to highlight environment variable support and improved systemd user service installation.
- Expanded setup instructions and dependency details.
- Provided clearer configuration guidance, especially regarding secure storage of API keys (via environment variables).
- No code changes; documentation and licensing improvements only.

Initial public release.

- Added tool to check MiniMax API Token remaining quota.
- Supports scheduled checks with Telegram notifications.
- Includes options for manual checking, scheduled monitoring, and running as a Linux system service.
- Provides configuration instructions and usage examples.
- Requires Python and the requests library.

- Renamed main script from minimax_token.py to scripts/minimax_token.py
- Added a README.md file with setup and usage instructions
- Removed the original minimax_token.py from the root directory

- Initial release of minimax-token skill.
- Check MiniMax API Token remaining quota and send Telegram notifications.
- Supports manual balance check, scheduled monitoring, and low-balance alerts.
- Includes configuration instructions, system service setup, and cron job support.
- Output quota status in a concise, user-friendly format.
